title: Dealer visits for service and repairs
summary: This topic centers on customers being told or planning to bring the G60 to a dealer for inspection, service, or repairs, with most fragments not stating a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review simply notes a planned dealer visit related to a suspected shock absorber noise without expressing dissatisfaction.

negative.summary: Negative reviews express frustration about having to bring the vehicle in so an issue can be addressed or serviced.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention recommendations or plans to bring the vehicle to the dealer for checks, service, diagnostics, maintenance, or repairs without clear approval or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined and only describe intended or advised dealer visits, which limits insight into clear customer sentiment.
The topic is narrow and repetitive, so examples provide limited detail about the underlying vehicle issues or repair outcomes.
Some undetermined fragments imply inconvenience or repair history, but the supplied sentiment labels do not allow reclassifying them as negative.
